entry.title: No free lattice contains an infinite ascending chain of copies of FL(3)
entry.summary:
No free lattice contains an infinite strictly ascending chain of sublattices isomorphic to FL(3), the free lattice on three generators; this answers a question that R. A. Dean asked and the second author's 1997 notes on the problem left open. Every such chain would yield, inside FL(3), a coherent chain of proper self-embeddings $Θ_0, Θ_1, Θ_2, \dots$ with $Θ_k \circ Θ_j = Θ_j$ for $j < k$, so that each later embedding fixes the image of each earlier one pointwise.

Source: arXiv CS (Formal Languages, Logic & Verification) · Tags: #formal-proofs #compilers #algebra-geometry #logic
